# f5xc_namespace (Resource)

namespace creates logical independent workspace within a tenant. Within a namespace contained objects should have unique names.<br><br>Object within a namespace can only refer to objects within the same namespace or shared namespace or ves-io/shared namespace<br><br>All monitoring is scoped by namespace<br><br>List within namespace lists objects within same namespace or shared namespace or ves-io/shared namespace<br><br>User roles can be scoped by namespace<br><br>The 'namespace' value of a namespace object itself is empty string

To get more information about f5xc_namespace, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/namespace)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Namespace - Full

resource "f5xc_namespace" "example" {
  name        = "example-namespace"
  description = "Full namespace example"

  labels = {
    env = "example"
  }

  annotations = {
    owner = "platform-team"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) name This is the name of configuration object. It has to be unique within the namespace. It can only be specified during create API and cannot be changed during replace API. The value of name has to follow DNS-1035 format.

### Optional

- `allow_advertise_on_public` (List of String) Allow advertisement on public. Config choice to allow advertisement on the public.<br>**Allowed Values (choose one):** `['Default', 'Disable', 'Enable']`<br>**Default:** `Default`<br>**Default:** `Default`
- `annotations` (Map of String) annotations Annotations is an unstructured key value map stored with a resource that may be set by external tools to store and retrieve arbitrary metadata. They are not queryable and should be preserved when modifying objects.
- `description` (String) description Human readable description for the object
- `labels` (Map of String) labels Map of string keys and values that can be used to organize and categorize (scope and select) objects as chosen by the user. Values specified here will be used by selector expression
- `proxy_sub_ca_latest_version` (Number) Proxy Sub CA Version SubCA version which is the latest and will be used for proxy feature.
- `proxy_sub_cas` (Attributes List) Proxy Sub CAs Array of SubCAs, the latest one will be used for proxy feature. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy_sub_cas))
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `namespace` (String) namespace This defines the workspace within which each the configuration object is to be created. Must be a DNS_LABEL format. For a namespace object itself, namespace value will be ''
- `uid` (String) uid uid is the unique in time and space value for this object. Object create will fail if provided by the client and the value exists in the system. Typically generated by the server on successful creation of an object and is not allowed to change once populated. Shadowed by SystemObjectMeta's uid field.

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an `import` block to import this resource by ID.

> **Note:** Replace placeholder values (for example, `<namespace>`, `<name>`) with actual values.

#### Command-Line Import

Use the following `command` to import this resource from the command line:

```shell
terraform import f5xc_namespace.example <name>
```

#### HCL Import Block

Use the following `hcl` block to import this resource during `plan` or `apply`:

```hcl
import {
	id = "<name>"
	to = "f5xc_namespace.example"
}
```
